title: Rippling Water Surface with Stone Splash
notes: 1920x1080 slow motion (source 60 fps, here 30 fps at real speed: no time stretch). 0-0.6 s: calm grey rippled water. 0.6-1.3 s: dark stone falls in from the top (x~0.5). 1.4-3.5 s: impact at x~0.55, y~0.55: a clear water dome rises, then a tall jagged column; dark mud and grit spray out to the left (x 0.3-0.55). 3.5-5.5 s: the column collapses and leaves a dark mud ring. 5.5-12.4 s: the mud ring spreads into a wide circle (x 0.35-0.95, y 0.75-0.9). Subject x~0.55, y~0.55, drifting lower and right as the ring spreads. Shot A: 0.3-2.9 s (stone falls, dome). Shot B: 2.7-5.4 s (column, mud burst) or 5.5-8 s (mud ring).
